docs.title: Welcome to My Portfolio
docs.text:
This is the personal portfolio of Mohammed Saajid. Here you can find information about my projects, skills, and experiences.

Feel free to explore and get in touch!

And Why does this site look like documentation?

While I can architect and train ML Models, design backend systems, I am not into web designing and development (And designing hates me too!). So, I used MkDocs with Material for MkDocs theme to quickly set up this portfolio site.

Continue to explore to see my work and projects! About Me

docs.title: About Me
docs.text: Hello! I'm Mohammed Saajid, I love building scalable backend systems and architecting machine learning models. I have experience working with various technologies and frameworks to create efficient and robust solutions. I enjoy learning new things and taking on challenges that help me grow both personally and professionally. I love to work on both engineering and research aspects of machine learning and software development. I also love to teach.
